articles.summary: Advanced Energy today launched a single-whip option for its 33 kW ORv3 High-Power Rack (HPR) power shelf at the 2026 OCP Global Summit. The option provides one AC power connection per shelf, with separate left- and right-side input configurations to accommodate different data center rack layouts.
